name: crimson
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided Shaula game sprite sheet into the enraged CRIMSON PHASE. This is a six-column six-row transparent animation sheet, NOT a poster. Preserve exactly all 36 cells, all silhouettes, all animations, camera angle, body proportions, frame alignment, tail lengths and big bone-white claw tips. Change ONLY the charcoal-black armored chitin surfaces to deep rich blood-crimson red plates with dark burgundy shadows and warm coral-red edge highlights. Keep ivory joints and claw edges IVORY, white star on stinger WHITE, outlines almost black. It must be exactly the SAME giant heavy eight-legged scorpion with two enormous pincers, not a new creature. Its eyes glow warm white. Do not add a red overlay/background or aura obscuring anatomy. All six row motions remain: idle, walk, claw grab, ground slam, infernal tail shot, forward sting. Keep square chunky pixel art, limited palette, transparent alpha background, no text, no grid, no logos, no humans. Exact six equal columns and six equal rows, no cropping of limbs.

name: specials
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW transparent game animation sheet for Shaula. Provided image is CHARACTER AND PIXEL STYLE reference ONLY: use the identical massive black armored scorpion, pale bone joint gaps and enormous ivory-tipped black claws, eight legs, long articulated tail with WHITE STAR on sting, front-left-facing top-down 3/4 viewpoint. Giant boss, not cute tiny animal. Fixed same body anchor, same scale and viewpoint. Make six equal columns and six equal rows (36 sprites) on a square transparent canvas. NO TEXT, NO GRID, NO LABELS, no background or painted checkerboard. Every full sprite has TRANSPARENT GUTTER inside its cell; no claws or tail touching cell boundaries. Hard pixel clusters, limited flat pixel palette; avoid antialiased sketch lines, gradients and smooth painting. Read frames left-to-right. ROW1 STAR BOMBARDMENT:6 frames tail raises almost vertical, compact star-like red magic charges at sting, repeatedly fires glowing tiny motes upward, then recoils and rests. ROW2 NEEDLE VOLLEY:6 frames tail aims down-left, small distinct repeated white-red flashes at stinger in frames2,3,4, single short magical needle leaves, then rests; NO background beam. ROW3 TAIL BREAK:6 frames full black scorpion takes hit at tail base, bright magical spark, upper tail segments dissolve into small CHITIN particles, final3 frames show the SAME black boss with just a SHORT BLUNT TAIL STUMP and NO tall tail, claws spread more aggressively; no blood or severed flesh. ROW4 TAIL REGENERATION:6 frames start with SAME TAILLESS scorpion, tail grows segment by segment upward, then final frame restores complete star-marked tail with small circular magic burst; no explosions obscuring body. ROW5 CRIMSON RAGE TRANSFORMATION:6 frames begin black chitin, dark burgundy spreads across armor plates, then deep crimson red armor in final2 frames with a few red sparks. SAME giant anatomy, ivory claw edges remain ivory. ROW6 FINAL DEFEAT:6 frames the SAME GIANT CRIMSON scorpion buckles, crimson chitin cracks into armor pieces, full giant shell crumbles with no blood, leaving a VERY SMALL RED SCORPION about ONE SIXTH the giant width standing AT THE SAME BODY ANCHOR in final2 frames. Mini scorpion is harmless, simplified but recognizable; big frame spacing stays unchanged so the shrink is obvious. Same strong silhouette and quality as reference, entire limbs and stinger visible.
